title: ESPN League-Wide Injury Feed
description: Snapshots league-wide injury reports from ESPN's public injuries endpoints for the four major US leagues (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL). Each row identifies athlete, team, status (Out / Day-To-Day / Questionable / Injured Reserve / etc.), injury type, and a short comment when available. No authentication required - ESPN publishes these endpoints openly. Powers the Sports Betting Edge Brief: late-breaking star-player injuries are one of the highest-edge signals in pre-game line movement.
